basic_info.description: 1 BD &1 BA |  PARKING | ELEVATOR | STORAGE | 99 WALK SCORE | This modern condo was converted in year 2005/2004. This boutique condo offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, secured building, deeded 1-car Parking, elevator, storage unit, two courtyards. Enjoy the tranquil courtyards, a peaceful oasis.  Enjoy the best of Polk and Hyde street, with restaurants, cafe and shops just steps away, and take advantage of convenient public transportation options on Van Ness and Hyde. Located at the cross roads of Russian Hill, Pacific Heights and Cow Hollow, this properties offers the best of San Francisco's upscale living. Enjoy the open layout living area with plenty of natural light. The spacious living room with bamboo floors, boasts a fireplace and a wall of windows. The kitchen features sleek black counter tops and stainless steel appliances. The spacious bedroom with dual closets and en-suite bath is tucked away. This upscale one-bedroom condo is the perfect blend of convenient and sophisticated lifestyle.  Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's vibrant Russian Hill neighborhood. Washer/Dryer can be installed in unit. Not a TIC!
